lua.title: Lua: fibonacci
lua.code:
local function fib(n)
    if n < 2 then return n end
    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
end
for n = 10, 25, 5 do
    print("fib(" .. n .. ") = " .. fib(n))
end

lua.title: Lua: patterns
lua.code:
local words = {}
for w in ("the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"):gmatch("%a+") do
    words[#words + 1] = w:upper()
end
print(table.concat(words, " "))
print(string.format("%d words, pi = %.6f", #words, math.pi))

lua.title: Lua: closures and coroutines
lua.code:
local function counter()
    local n = 0
    return function() n = n + 1; return n end
end
local c = counter()
print(c(), c(), c())
local gen = coroutine.wrap(function()
    for i = 1, 3 do coroutine.yield(i * i) end
end)
print(gen(), gen(), gen())
